context: Request: full list of general-litigation matters where the firm sought fee-shifting, with the underlying documents. Rubric: 14 matters (1006-00005, 1008-00007, 1010-00005, 1012-00006, 1019-00005, 1020-00005, 1021-00006, 1023-00002, 1024-00003, 1027-00003, 1033-00006, 1035-00004, 1038-00007, 1044-00006) each with a proof document, plus a precision criterion (1045-00004 also permitted).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Two batches of reads of pleadings, motions and memos of the matter at the top of the listing; one guessed path does not exist.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for fee and cost terms; times out after about 45K chars of snippets.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of four candidate matters picked from the scan output (including the one read first).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the opening of pleadings, briefs and approval motions of three candidate matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet-extraction script over eight named documents of those matters for fee and cost language.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes three matters whose papers sought fees or costs.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The one store-wide scan timed out before reaching nearly all qualifying matters; it answered with matters from that partial output, none of them qualifying.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its store-wide extraction scan timed out before reaching most of the matters it needed; it did not narrow the scan by matter range or folder, rerun it, or search file names, and worked from the partial output.

other_errors.why: It counted matters from other practice areas as qualifying because their papers sought fees or costs, without checking whether they belonged to the docket the request named.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The scan timed out after reaching only one qualifying matter; it skimmed six candidates and listed many matters, most outside the set.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its one store-wide scan timed out with only one of the matters it needed in the output; it did not narrow or rerun the scan or search file names, and chose candidates from the partial output.

other_errors.why: It asserted many matters as qualifying from scan snippets and first-page skims, including matters of the same clients under other matter numbers and matters from other practice areas.

divergence: All three runs failed the same way: after reading the matter at the top of the listing, each ran a store-wide extraction scan that timed out before reaching most qualifying matters (first error at the scan stage, search-miss), then answered with matters from the partial output, most of them outside the qualifying set (over-inclusion).
